This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the
following:
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.190/2023, registered at Police Station-Saman,
District-Rewa (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 11.05.2023.
Applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is aged about 24 years and major.
It is submitted that applicant is married to prosecutrix.
In view of aforesaid circumstance, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

5. In view of aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that applicant is in jail since 11.05.2023, and trial will take considerable time for its conclusion, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules (VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE Date: 2023.06.20 16:22:50 +05'30' shabana Nagendra Chourasiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139736008/
